app.name: Horizon
app.tagline: Personal portfolio tracker – every account in one place
app.notTaxAdvice: Every result and return figure is a portfolio analysis estimate, not tax data.

login.title: Sign in
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.linkError: The link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.verifyIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.staleIntro: For security, you need to enter the code again every 12 hours.
mfa.enrollIntro: This account has no authenticator app set up yet. Scan the QR code (e.g. with Google Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code.
mfa.manualKey: If you cannot scan it, enter this key by hand:
mfa.error: The code is wrong or has expired. Try again with the next code.
mfa.loadError: The authenticator details could not be loaded. Reload the page.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app

reauth.title: Enter the code again
reauth.intro: For security, this action needs a fresh code. The form you filled in is kept.

access.title: No access
access.notApproved: This authenticator has not been approved yet. Until it is, no data is shown.

common.estimatedHint: Estimated cost basis (the market value on the opening day or on the correction's day).
common.incompleteHint: A fee could not be converted, so the result is incomplete.
common.confirmDelete: Delete it? This cannot be undone.

eventTypeHints.buy: Buying a security. The fee is part of the cost basis.
eventTypeHints.sell: Selling a security. The realised gain is computed FIFO (an estimate).
eventTypeHints.dividend: Gross dividend, with the tax withheld given separately.
eventTypeHints.dividend_reinvest: New units bought at once from the dividend. An accumulating (Acc) fund has no such entry.
eventTypeHints.split: The number of units changes by the ratio; the total cost basis does not.
eventTypeHints.fx_exchange: Neither income nor expense. The actual rate is stored with the transaction.
eventTypeHints.deposit: Money comes into the portfolio from outside (an external flow).
eventTypeHints.withdrawal: Money leaves the portfolio (an external flow).
eventTypeHints.transfer: An internal move: not a flow at portfolio level. For a security the cost basis moves too.
eventTypeHints.interest: Interest on the money in the account, or a government bond's interest paid in cash.
eventTypeHints.opening_balance: The account's state at the end of its tracking start date. This is how you enter what happened before.
eventTypeHints.correction: Only for a difference of unknown cause. If the cause is known, record the real event.
eventTypeHints.interest_reinvest: MÁP Plusz interest in bonds of the same series: as many forints of interest, as many forints of nominal value. The Awaiting review list offers this by itself too.
eventTypeHints.maturity: The Awaiting review list offers the maturity for approval.

overview.title: Overview
overview.staleShare: {share} of the total is on a stale price or a manual value.
overview.missing: Items left out of the total for a missing price or FX rate: {count}.
overview.resultHint: change in value without deposits and withdrawals
overview.largeFlows: There were large money movements in the period, so the return is less precise.
overview.incomplete: The period's figures are incomplete for a missing price or FX rate.
overview.emptyText: Three steps, and your wealth shows:
emptySteps: Create an account with its tracking start date.
Add the instruments (stock, ETF, manually valued item).
Record the opening balances, then the transactions.

positions.title: Positions
positions.note: Gains are computed in the instrument's own currency, FIFO (an estimate). In the display currency only the value is shown.
positions.emptyCash: No cash in the accounts yet.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.kept: {text} · the money stayed in the account
transactions.deleteEntryIntro: Every line of the entry is deleted, with its deposit and withdrawal if it had one. If an instrument has no other entry left, the instrument is deleted too, with its prices.
transactions.deleteEventIntro: If an instrument has no other entry left, the instrument is deleted too, with its prices.
transactions.returnToReviewIntro: The entry is deleted and the proposal goes back to the Awaiting review list, where you can change it and approve it again.

txForm.title: Advanced operations
txForm.openingDate: The date is always the account's tracking start date: {date}.
txForm.totalHint: If the broker rounded, give the exact amount; the unit price is then optional.
txForm.ratioHint: For example 1 → 4 (a four-for-one split) or 10 → 1 (a consolidation).
txForm.openingPrice: Unit price on the opening day
txForm.openingPriceHint: Also recorded as a manual price for the opening day.
txForm.openingValueHint: Also recorded as a manual value for the opening day.
txForm.costHint: If unknown, the opening market value is used, marked “estimated”.
txForm.correctionPriceHint: If empty, the day's selected price. The cost basis will be estimated.
txForm.needAccounts: A transaction needs an account first.
txForm.needInstruments: This type needs an instrument first.
txForm.interestBondHint: If it is one of your government bonds' interest, choose it and give the interest payment day as the date: then Awaiting review will not offer it again.
txForm.interestNoBond: None – interest on the money in the account
txForm.interestCreditedHint: The amount on your statement. As many forints, as many forints of nominal value arrive in bonds of the same series.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.name: Name
accounts.trackingStartHint: What happened before it is the opening balance. It can only move earlier later, while there is no opening holding.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. On the “New entry” page you can add the broker, the account and today's holding in one step.
accounts.noAccounts: This institution has no accounts yet.
accounts.trackingStartEditHint: Only earlier, and only while there is no opening holding.
accounts.deleteIntro: Everything on the account is deleted with it. This cannot be undone, but the log keeps it.
accounts.deleteSummary: Deleted: entries {entries}, advanced operations {events}, manual values {values}.
accounts.deleteTransfers: Transfers are deleted from the other account too ({count}).
accounts.deleteBroker: The broker is deleted too, as this is its last account.
accounts.deleteInstruments: These instruments are deleted too, with their prices, as they have no entries elsewhere: {names}.
accounts.confirmName: To confirm, type the account's name: {name}
accounts.updateValueIntro: The new value goes into the log; the change in value shows as return and records no flow.

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.name: Name
instruments.priceSourceHint: Yahoo and BÉT: the Refresh button fetches the price and the missing history. Manual: you give the price. A government bond's (ÁKK) source is set by the New entry form. After a change of source the value comes only from the new source and the manual prices.
instruments.providerSymbolHint: Yahoo: the symbol as on the Yahoo Finance page (for example VWCE.DE, AAPL). BÉT: the BÉT code (for example ETFCETOPOTP, OTP).
instruments.staleAfterHint: Empty: 3 working days for a market price, 35 days for a manual value.
instruments.currencyHint: It can be changed only while it has no entry, price or value.
instruments.inUse: Entries use it, so it cannot be deleted.

prices.title: Prices and FX rates
prices.intro: An append-only log: a correction is a new line, the original stays.
prices.correctIntro: The new line takes the corrected line's place, on its day. The original stays in the log.
prices.rateHint: 1 unit of the first currency = this many units of the second.

settings.title: Settings
settings.factorsIntro: Approval lives in the database: with an unapproved authenticator no data is shown.
settings.sessionsIntro: If you suspect someone else has access, sign out on every device and change the password.
settings.passwordText: Changing the password needs a fresh code. Your other devices are then signed out.

errors.positive: Enter a number greater than zero.
errors.future: It cannot be a future date.
errors.beforeStart: The date must be after the account's tracking start date. What came before is the opening balance.
errors.sameAccount: The two accounts cannot be the same.
errors.sameCurrency: The two currencies cannot be the same.
errors.insufficient: The account does not hold that many units on this day.
errors.noHolding: The account has no such position on this day.
errors.noPrice: There is no price for this day: give the unit price.
errors.noFxFee: There is no FX rate for this day to convert the fee. Record a rate first.
errors.isin: An ISIN has 12 characters: 2 letters, 9 letters or digits, 1 digit.
errors.currency: A three-letter currency code (for example EUR).
errors.notManual: This instrument is not manually valued.
errors.invalid: The entry is not valid. Check the fields.
errors.history: This would contradict another entry (for example a later sale would not have enough units left).
errors.cashUsedLater: A later buy was paid from this money, so the account would go negative. Change or delete that buy first.
errors.denied: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.server: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again.
errors.pageText: The page could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.passwordRules: Use lower-case and upper-case letters and a digit.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.samePassword: The new password cannot be the same as the old one.
errors.weakPassword: This password is too weak. Choose a longer or less guessable one.
errors.reauthNeeded: The session is more than 24 hours old. Sign out, sign in again, then try again.
errors.symbolRequired: For the Yahoo price source give the symbol (for example VWCE.DE), for the BÉT price source the BÉT code (for example ETFCETOPOTP).
errors.symbolNotFound: Yahoo does not know this symbol.
errors.unsupportedCurrency: The app cannot handle this security's currency (for example GBp). Add it as a manually valued item.
errors.emptyOpening: Give at least one instrument or one cash line.
errors.oneRow: When editing, one line can be saved.
errors.beforeStartOpening: The date must be after the tracking start date: what came before is already in the opening holding.
errors.noValue: This item has no value on this day yet. Update its value first.
errors.insufficientValue: The amount taken out is more than the item's value on this day.
errors.feeTooHigh: The fee cannot be more than the sale's amount.
errors.notFound: Not found: it may have been deleted meanwhile. Reload the page.
errors.inUse: Entries use this instrument, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.trackingLater: The tracking start date can only move earlier.
errors.trackingHasOpening: With an opening holding the start date cannot change. Delete the opening lines first.
errors.currencyLocked: The currency can no longer change: the instrument has an entry, a price or a value.
errors.nameMismatch: The name typed does not match the account's name.
errors.yahooUnavailable: Yahoo cannot be reached right now. Try again, or give the price by hand.
errors.duplicateSymbol: An instrument with this symbol or BÉT code already exists.
errors.akkTotalRequired: For an earlier day give the amount paid from your contract note – the ÁKK gives today's price only.
errors.akkNoEstimate: The Treasury gives no selling price for this bond today. Give the amount paid from your contract note.
errors.matured: The bond had already matured on this day. You can approve the repayment on the Awaiting review list.
errors.maturityBooked: This bond's Maturity is already approved, and this entry would change how much it repaid. First send the Maturity back for review on the Transactions page, then record this entry and approve the Maturity again.
errors.seriesNotFound: This series is not on the ÁKK's list today. Check its name (for example 2031/M5).
errors.akkUnavailable: The ÁKK cannot be reached right now. Try again later, or give the amount paid.
errors.betUnavailable: The BÉT cannot be reached right now. Try again, or give the price by hand.
errors.betCodeNotFound: The BÉT gives no data for this code: it is not on its list, or it has had no data for a year. You can add it as a manually valued item.
errors.earlierFirst: Settle the earlier proposal first: the same bond has an earlier open or postponed proposal.
errors.amountRequired: Give the amount from your statement.
errors.pendingGone: This proposal is no longer open. Reload the page.
errors.pendingChanged: The proposal was updated meanwhile. Check the new amount and approve it again.

forgot.title: Forgotten password
forgot.intro: Give your email address. If an account belongs to it, we send a link for a new password.
forgot.sent: If the address is known, the email has been sent. Open the link in this browser. The email may land in the spam folder.

password.title: Change password
password.intro: At least 12 characters, with lower-case and upper-case letters and a digit. Your password manager's suggestion is a good choice.
password.success: The password has changed. Your other devices have been signed out.

export.title: Data export
export.intro: The download needs a fresh code, no older than 15 minutes. The file downloads to your browser; no copy stays on the server.
export.csvNote: The CSV is made for machines: comma separator, point as the decimal mark, UTF-8 encoding.

refresh.hint: FX rates from the MNB and the ECB, prices from Yahoo and the ÁKK, with the missing history.
refresh.continued: Items continuing with the next refresh: {count}.
refresh.keepLast: On an error the last valid price stays in force.
refresh.splitWarning: Yahoo reports a split ({day}, ratio: {ratio}): {name}. Record the split, or the value computed after it is wrong.

messages.http_429: the source reported too many requests
messages.rate_limited: later, because of the source's limits
messages.rule_mismatch: unchecked: the interest calculation differs from the ÁKK's right now, so Horizon gives no computed interest
messages.not_listed: the ÁKK's list has no such series right now

refresh.logIntro: Item by item: what was asked for, and what arrived.
refresh.summary: Refreshed. New FX rates: {fx}, new prices: {prices}.

entryForm.title: New entry

tabHints.buy: What you bought, when, for how much, and where you hold it. Enter your older investments you still hold here too, with the day you bought them; if you do not know the exact price, leave it empty.
tabHints.sell: What you sold, when, and for how much.

entryForm.oldOpening: This is an old “Today's holding” entry, which the form no longer records. To change it, delete it among the Transactions and enter it as a buy with the day you bought it.
entryForm.buyPriceYahoo: If left empty, Yahoo's close for that day: {price} ({date}).
entryForm.buyPriceLater: If left empty, Yahoo's close for that day, at saving.
entryForm.buyPriceNeeded: Yahoo has no price for this day: give it, or choose another exchange (for example one ending in .MI or .L).
entryForm.buyPriceBet: If left empty, the BÉT's close for that day: {price} ({date}).
entryForm.buyPriceLaterBet: If left empty, the BÉT's close for that day, at saving.
entryForm.buyPriceNeededBet: The BÉT has no close for this day: give the price.
entryForm.totalHint: If you give it, this counts, not units × unit price.
entryForm.newValueHintBuy: If left empty: the previous value + the amount paid in.
entryForm.newValueHintSell: If left empty: the previous value − the amount taken out.
entryForm.payFromCashAll: Available: {available}. The whole buy comes from it; no deposit is recorded.
entryForm.payFromCashPartial: Available: {available}. The missing {rest} is recorded as a deposit.
entryForm.payFromDepositHint: The {available} in the account stays untouched.
entryForm.proceedsKeepHint: The proceeds become the account's cash; you can use them for the next buy.
entryForm.proceedsWithdrawHint: A withdrawal is recorded for the same day too: the money leaves the tracked wealth.
entryForm.noHoldings: This account has nothing to sell.
entryForm.advanced: Advanced operations (dividend, split, currency exchange, correction…)
entryForm.refreshed: FX rates and prices have been refreshed too.
entryForm.refreshFailed: The refresh did not succeed now; you can catch up later with the Refresh button.
entryForm.bondEntry: You approved this entry on the Awaiting review list. To change it, send it back for review among the Transactions: the proposal returns to the list, where you can edit it.
entryForm.akkTotalHint: As on your contract note. Required for an earlier day, as the ÁKK gives today's price only.
entryForm.akkTotalTodayHint: As on your contract note. If left empty, it is estimated from the Treasury's selling price today.
entryForm.heldNominal: In the account now: {amount} nominal value

picker.queryHint: Searches the BÉT first, then Yahoo if it is not there. For example CETOP, OTP or VWCE.DE.
picker.noneOnBet: The BÉT has no such security.
picker.betDown: The BÉT cannot be reached right now.
picker.none: No results. Try the exact symbol (for example VWCE.DE), or add it as a manually valued item.
picker.sameManual: Such a manual item already exists; saving uses it.
picker.akkNone: No such series on the ÁKK's list today.

pending.title: Awaiting review ({count})
pending.intro: Horizon computes interest and maturities from the ÁKK's data. Nothing is booked without your approval.
pending.heading: {date} · {kind} · {name}
pending.missing: Data missing – give it from your statement
pending.missingRate: Horizon has not seen this period's interest rate.
pending.unverified: The series' calculation does not match the ÁKK's right now.
pending.unchecked: Horizon could not check this series against the ÁKK's data yet.
pending.payoutKeep: Stays in the account as cash
pending.payoutKeepHint: You can buy from it later; the Buy form offers it.
pending.payoutWithdraw: I took it out of the account

flags.incomplete: Incomplete – you dismissed an interest credit
